title: Student section, half price, ten minutes
scenario: A student-group account offers last-minute sports tickets at half price and says the transfer window closes in ten minutes. Payment must be sent by a peer-to-peer app before the ticket is transferred.

answers.A: Send half now to hold the seat and the rest after transfer.
answers.B: Use a ticket platform with verified transfer/buyer protection or skip the deal.
answers.C: Ask for a live screen recording of the ticket inside the official ticket app and verify the seller independently.

explanation: Short windows create fear of missing out and encourage irreversible payment. Transaction protection matters more than student affiliation.
proTip: Campus identity is not buyer protection.
